name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-06-04, at wavelengths from 1.07 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
